LcList.name: Launcher.BoundaryRule
array: Rule: EF.Launcher may only reference AOT-resident assemblies, never any hot update assembly; EF.Core is the sole allowlisted EF assembly and its access is confined to LauncherCoreBridge. The HybridCLR hot update list is the authoritative source; third-party assemblies vendored inside EF packages (UniTask / YooAsset) are judged by assembly name.
